# The status the hook writes about itself when system_server starts
# (sandboxStatusText in SandboxRules.kt and bbd/src/sandbox/identity.rs),
# read by the tests of both. A case is the whole file. The format of the
# cases is in README.md.
#
# line    the hook writes the file for the meaning; the daemon reads from
#         it which hooks are in place
# read    the daemon reads which hooks are in place; the hook does not
#         write the file in this form
#
# The meaning: what the hook reports, android_id=, app_list=, uri_grants=, ad_id= and list=
# (1 or 0, list being whether it could read the sandbox list), api= and
# boot=; in_place=, the hooks the daemon counts as in place in that boot,
# separated by /; for a read case, now=, the boot the daemon reads it in.

line	android_id=1\napp_list=1\nuri_grants=1\nad_id=1\napi=35\nlist=1\nboot=abc-1\n	android_id=1	app_list=1	uri_grants=1	ad_id=1	api=35	list=1	boot=abc-1	in_place=android_id/app_list/uri_grants/ad_id
line	android_id=1\napp_list=0\nuri_grants=0\nad_id=0\napi=35\nlist=1\nboot=abc-1\n	android_id=1	app_list=0	uri_grants=0	ad_id=0	api=35	list=1	boot=abc-1	in_place=android_id
line	android_id=0\napp_list=1\nuri_grants=1\nad_id=1\napi=31\nlist=1\nboot=abc-1\n	android_id=0	app_list=1	uri_grants=1	ad_id=1	api=31	list=1	boot=abc-1	in_place=app_list/uri_grants/ad_id
# The hook could not read the list.
line	android_id=1\napp_list=1\nuri_grants=1\nad_id=1\napi=35\nlist=0\nboot=abc-1\n	android_id=1	app_list=1	uri_grants=1	ad_id=1	api=35	list=0	boot=abc-1	in_place=

# Left from a boot in which the hook was there.
read	android_id=1\napp_list=1\napi=35\nlist=1\nboot=abc-1\n	now=abc-2	in_place=
read	android_id=1\napp_list=1\napi=35\nlist=1\nboot=abc-1\n	now=	in_place=
# Written by a hook from before the file grants were withheld.
read	android_id=1\napp_list=1\napi=35\nlist=1\nboot=abc-1\n	now=abc-1	in_place=android_id/app_list
# Written by a hook from before the advertising ID was withheld.
read	android_id=1\napp_list=1\nuri_grants=1\napi=35\nlist=1\nboot=abc-1\n	now=abc-1	in_place=android_id/app_list/uri_grants
# Written by a hook that does not say which boot.
read	android_id=1\napp_list=1\napi=35\n	now=abc-1	in_place=
read		now=abc-1	in_place=
